title: 图片轻装
description: 缩放、压缩和转换图片，比较原图与结果体积并下载。

tests.note: 8 pure helper/property tests and 1 static source regression assertion

flows: Download event complete and actual JPEG dimensions verified via PIL
Width0 error disables download; reset restores output
File chooser of downloaded original sample JPEG completed successfully → WebP2.4KB
v4 removes all no-login/local-processing badges, duplicate subtitle/footer and redundant success prose; sample workflow rechecked
v5 empty state shows one choose action and one sample action; toolbar appears only after processing; title and metadata stripped implementation wording
v6 CSS-only hierarchy: high-contrast output summary joined to download, stronger control labels, quieter settings
limits: Narrow CSS layout implemented but real narrow/mobile viewport not tested
Unsupported-browser format fallback not reproduced; MIME/extension mapping unit tested
Invalid replacement file error retention covered by source regression assertion, not browser file test

interaction: 选择图片，调整宽度、格式与画质，比较体积后下载。
